verification.sourceReview: Complete institutional text, language provenance, first-publication evidence, permissions, third-party exclusions, factual claims, Chinese translations and editorial level estimates independently reviewed. dateAndIdentityNotes: Seven distinct complete works were first published November 9–11. Source dates are separate from edition dates and historical statistical periods.

The German OER anniversary essay has matching November 10 publication dates in the official page, RSS and institutional index. Its modification date is November 3, an unresolved metadata anomaly. Independent comparison with the June event report confirms distinct authorship and complete work, not a reissued fragment.

The INRAE article was previously an explicitly unadapted reserve entry. The known reserve and recovered final publication packet were reconciled before conversion. The Culture bill announcement previously appeared only as a press-listing link.
Missing historical inventories remain missing. Clearance applies only to these verified new works, not unknown older candidates.
rightsNotes: Culture institutional text and all adapted teaching remain CC BY-SA 3.0 FR under the specific text clause. INRAE public institutional text is under Etalab 2.0.
Istat, INGV and the specifically licensed OERinfo text are CC BY 4.0 with required attribution. Treasury and Defra institutional prose are under OGL v3.0; third-party quotations are excluded.
